title: Wintergrasp
body: Wintergrasp is a frozen valley in west-central Northrend, dotted with titan fortifications and rich in elemental materials, and both make it a prize. At its northern end stands Wintergrasp Fortress, which guards the way into the Vault of Archavon, and the Alliance and the Horde fight over it again and again. No victory here is more than temporary: between battles one side garrisons the keep while the other gathers at the valley's edge, and soldiers of both scour the land for materials and kill each other for them.

title: Wintergrasp Fortress
body: Wintergrasp Fortress stands at the northern end of the valley, the prize every battle is fought for, guarded by two rings of walls, a great gate and four corner towers. Within lie two goblin workshops that can never be taken from the defenders, and behind the innermost door the chamber where an attacking army must claim the titan relic to win. Here too opens the way into the Vault of Archavon, which only the side holding the fortress may enter.

title: The Southern Towers
body: South of the Wintergrasp River stand three fortified towers, Shadowsight, Winter's Edge and Flamewatch, and in every battle they stand with the army besieging the fortress, so stoutly built that only siege engines can bring one down. Goblin and gnomish workshops across the field turn out the catapults, demolishers and siege engines that do it.

parts.body: The towers draw power away from the fortress, its officers say, and when one falls that power can be turned back into the titan relic to strengthen the defenders.
